name: GET /api/trust-pack - packs, client clause and data-use settings
description: Any member (projects:read). Lists the two packs on offer (validation, data-handling; PDF), the clause the firm can give its clients with the firm's name filled in and its review status, the firm's data-use settings (AI training never; product-improvement use off by default) and the deletion and backup periods. Covers: a consultant can download the validation and data-handling packs as PDF (what is on offer); a consultant can copy client contract clause text; data-use settings show AI training never and product-improvement use off by default.
